name: main
evidence: called from _start; init, then the per-frame mode switch on game_mode (0x800AE204)

name: game_init
evidence: first call of main: CD, pads, graphics, mode = 0

name: cd_init
evidence: DsInit; DsSearchFile for TEKKEN3.BNS and TEKKEN3.XAS

name: bns_queue_read
evidence: (file id, dest): id via remap 0x80098574 to index 0x80024400 (sector, size); sorted read list

name: bns_start_reads
evidence: issues the queued reads as one DsPacket chain

name: bns_reads_pending
evidence: nonzero while queued reads run

name: bns_reset_queue
evidence: waits for and clears the read queue

name: bns_queue_moveset
evidence: file id 0x4A + moveset (0x49: the common bank)

name: container_section
evidence: u32 count; {offset,size}[]: pointer to section n

name: container_section_size
evidence: size of section n

name: container_section_alt
evidence: same as container_section (bounds-checked)

name: moveset_relocate
evidence: moves (0x38 bytes): motion, side tables and common-bank pointers made absolute

name: moveset_slot_of
evidence: which loaded bank slot (0/1) holds a moveset

name: moveset_relocate_header
evidence: the bank header's 13 section offsets made absolute

name: fighter_load_variant
evidence: BNS ids 95+4v..98+4v: 3DMK, VAB header, container, moveset bank

name: fighter_setup_model
evidence: TIM upload, 3DMK relocation, part slots

name: fighter_upload_tims
evidence: TIM chain to VRAM: pixels x+0x180, CLUT y+0x1F8 (player 2: +256 / +4)

name: model_relocate
evidence: 3DMK record offsets made absolute; hand tables

name: part_build_packets
evidence: prefills POLY_FT3/FT4/GT3/GT4 packets: CLUT, tpage and UVs from the texture block

name: part_slot_init
evidence: slot -> record/bone tables 0x8001A05C/0x8001A074; parent bone link; joint offset

name: bone_set_parent
evidence: bone +0x40 = parent matrix

name: fighter_draw_parts
evidence: 22 slots in order: light/rot/trans from the bone, part_draw per mesh

name: part_draw
evidence: vertex program (imports, RTPT, seam blends, exports), NCCT lighting, polygon packets

name: fighter_hand_shapes
evidence: per hand: shape index from fighter state, part_set_hand_shape

name: part_set_hand_shape
evidence: swaps a hand record's vertex block from its 41-entry table

name: fighter_animate
evidence: motion channels -> pose -> bones -> render, per fighter per frame

name: motion_eval_root
evidence: root position channels 0-2 of a move's motion at a frame

name: motion_eval_channels
evidence: all 49 channels of a move's motion at a frame (odd channels read time reversed)

name: motion_curve
evidence: delta-coded key spline (5-bit interval, 11-bit delta << channel shift) with basis tables 0x8009671C

name: motion_scale_root
evidence: root position * fighter scale (4.12)

name: pose_from_channels
evidence: 10 joint rotations + root + four two-bone IK limbs into the pose array

name: rot_matrix_xyz
evidence: rotation matrix from three 16-bit angles (sin/cos tables 0x8001E8C4/0x8001F0C4, GPF)

name: comp_matrix
evidence: out = parent * local (rotation via MVMVA, translation via MAC + parent)

name: ik_target_local
evidence: IK target into the limb root's frame

name: ik_two_bone
evidence: two-bone IK with fixed leg / arm lengths

name: fighter_build_bones
evidence: pose array (+ blend deltas) through the bone hierarchy into world and view matrices

name: fighter_motion_blend
evidence: on a move change: per-bone deltas old pose -> new pose, decayed over frames

name: fighter_replay_motion
evidence: records / plays back the animation state for replays

name: fight_step
evidence: one fight frame: input, moves, motion, collision, hits, camera, draw

name: mode_fight
evidence: game mode 8: round setup, fight_step each frame, round/match end

name: round_flow
evidence: round states: intro, fight, KO/time, replay, next round

name: replay_step
evidence: replay buffer state machine

name: fighter_control
evidence: per fighter: player (0), CPU (1) or demo (2) control

name: cpu_think
evidence: the CPU opponent's decisions (uses rand)

name: fighter_render
evidence: shadow + part drawing for one fighter
